title: Proteas star lands two huge early blows as Aussies in trouble in survival fight – LIVE
text:
Australia vs South Africa, cricket scores, second Test day four live updates and blog: Session times, how to watch, stream, updates from Gqeberha HOME CRICKET Aussies in huge trouble as top order crumbles in recurring nightmare – LIVE
 Khawaja: 'Opening is a specialist spot' | 02:36 Dane Heverin from Fox Sports October 21st, 2026 8:00 pm Australia’s chances of victory in the second Test in Gqeberha were all but ended by Temba Bavuma’s spectacular century – and now they are in a desperate survival fight after the top order crumbled. Live updates below! 
 The visitors endured a torrid Day 3 at St George’s Park , as Bavuma’s 179 combined with 85 from No.8 Marco Jansen and 82 from No.9 Simon Harmer to take the Proteas from 5/97 to 9/425 declared.
 Watch Australia’s Tour of South Africa Live & Exclusive on Fox Cricket, available on Kayo Sports. 
 Making matters worse, Nic Maddinson fell for a duck in the first over as the Aussies endured a challenging four-over burst before stumps to finish the day on 1/3.
 MATCH CENTRE: Live scores, updates and more! 
 Khawaja analyses Maddinson Test 2 duck | 01:26 
 Follow all the action from Gqeherba below in our live blog! Can’t see the blog? Tap here . 
 While Days 4 and 5 will be extended due to the rain-affected first two days, Australia’s chances of surging to a first-innings lead and leaving themselves time to take 10 further Proteas wickets look slim.
 However, star fast bowler Mitchell Starc is adamant it’s the hosts rather than them that need to make the play for the remainder of the match.
 “We’re 1-0 up, so it’s on South Africa,” he told SEN.
 When asked what Australia’s strategy would be, Starc’s answer was simple: “Just bat, and see where we get to”.
 Starc: "A dodgy prawn or something!" | 06:16 
 Former Australian opener David Warner also lamented the continued low crowds in Gqeberha, following on from poor attendances in the first Test in Durban.
 “We keep hearing how important Test cricket is, but where are the fans in South Africa?” he wrote on X. 
 “Empty stands, no atmosphere, and we’re supposed to believe the format is thriving? 
 “You can’t keep calling Test cricket the pinnacle of the game if no one turns up to watch it. 
 “Harsh reality, but someone has to say it. Pathetic.”
 Match details 
 Venue: St George’s Park, Gqeberha
 First ball: 6:45pm (AEDT)
 Watch it live: On Fox Cricket (channel 501), and streaming on Kayo, from 6pm (AEDT)
 Teams 
 Australia: Travis Head, Nic Maddinson, Marnus Labuschagne, Steve Smith, Matt Renshaw, Alex Carey (wk), Beau Webster, Pat Cummins (c), Mitchell Starc, Scott Boland, Josh Hazlewood
 South Africa:﻿ Aiden Markram, Marques Ackerman, David Bedingham, Temba Bavuma (c), Matthew Breetzke, Ryan Rickelton (wk), Wiaan Mulder, Marco Jansen, Simon Harmer, Kagiso Rabda, Anrich Nortje
